fields.name: ArgentSeaOrleansReminderTable IReminderTable operations
fields.contract: ArgentSeaOrleansReminderTable provides an IReminderTable implementation for its selected shard set. It reads one reminder by grain and name, reads all reminders for one grain (from that grain's Shard) or for a hash range (from every read Shard), removes a named reminder conditionally using its version text, exposes a completed no-op test-clear operation, and upserts a reminder. The multi-row reads return every matching row of every Shard queried, not one row per Shard. A missing single-row result is represented by a ReminderEntry bearing the requested GrainId; a successful upsert returns the new row version as an invariant-culture string; removal returns whether the row was found.
